# Ezekiel 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-I-looked, and-behold, upon the-expanse which [was] above-the-head-of the-cherubim, like-a-stone-of sapphire, like-the-appearance-of [the]-likeness-of a-throne, it-appeared above-them.

**2** And-He-spoke to the-man clothed-in the-linen, and-said, "Go into the-midst between the-wheelwork, under the-cherub, and-fill your-palms [with]-coals-of fire from-between the-cherubim, and-scatter [them] over the-city." And-he-went-in before-my-eyes.

**3** And-the-cherubim [were] standing to-the-right-of the-house when-the-man went-in, and-the-cloud filled the-inner court.

**4** And-the-glory-of YHWH rose from-upon the-cherub to the-threshold-of the-house, and-the-house was-filled with-the-cloud, and-the-court was-full-of the-brightness-of the-glory-of YHWH.

**5** And-the-sound-of the-wings-of the-cherubim was-heard to the-outer court, like-the-voice-of God Almighty when-He-speaks.

**6** And-it-was when-He-commanded the-man clothed-in the-linen, saying, "Take fire from-between the-wheelwork, from-between the-cherubim" — and-he-went-in and-stood beside the-wheel.

**7** And-the-cherub stretched-out his-hand from-between the-cherubim to the-fire which [was] between the-cherubim, and-he-lifted and-put [it] into the-palms-of the-one-clothed-in the-linen, and-he-took [it] and-went-out.

**8** And-there-appeared to-the-cherubim the-form-of a-hand-of a-human under their-wings.

**9** And-I-looked, and-behold, four wheels beside the-cherubim, one wheel beside each-cherub, and-one wheel beside each-cherub; and-the-appearance-of the-wheels [was] like-the-gleam-of a-stone-of Tarshish.

**10** And-their-appearance — one likeness to-the-four-of-them, as-if the-wheel were in-the-midst-of the-wheel.

**11** In-their-going, upon their-four sides they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going, for the-place where the-head would-face, after-it they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going.

**12** And-all their-flesh and-their-backs and-their-hands and-their-wings and-the-wheels [were] full-of eyes all-around — to-the-four-of-them their-wheels.

**13** To-the-wheels — to-them it-was-called 'the-wheelwork' in-my-hearing.

**14** And-four faces to-each — the-face-of the-first [was the]-face-of the-cherub, and-the-face-of the-second [was the]-face-of a-human, and-the-third [the]-face-of a-lion, and-the-fourth [the]-face-of an-eagle.

**15** And-the-cherubim rose — it [was] the-living-creature which I-saw by-the-river Chebar.

**16** And-in-the-going-of the-cherubim, the-wheels went beside-them; and-in-the-cherubim lifting their-wings to-rise from-upon the-earth, the-wheels also did-not-turn from-beside-them.

**17** In-their-standing, they-stood; and-in-their-rising, they-rose with-them, for the-spirit-of the-living-creature [was] in-them.

**18** And-the-glory-of YHWH went-out from-upon the-threshold-of the-house, and-stood over the-cherubim.

**19** And-the-cherubim lifted their-wings and-rose from-the-earth before-my-eyes in-their-going-out, and-the-wheels beside-them; and-it-stood [at the]-entrance-of the-gate-of the-house-of YHWH, the-eastern; and-the-glory-of the-God-of Israel [was] over-them from-above.

**20** It [was] the-living-creature which I-saw under the-God-of Israel by-the-river Chebar, and-I-knew that cherubim they [were].

**21** Four-four faces to-each, and-four wings to-each, and-[the]-likeness-of [the]-hands-of a-human under their-wings.

**22** And-[the]-likeness-of their-faces — they [were] the-faces which I-saw by-the-river Chebar, their-appearances and-themselves; each to-the-direction-of his-face they-would-go.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **10:2**: Gachalei-esh — 'coals of fire.' Fire from between the cherubim scattered over the city recalls the destruction of Sodom (Gen 19). The Temple's own sacred fire becomes the instrument of Jerusalem's judgment.

- **10:4,18-19**: The glory's staged departure: from cherub to threshold (v4), from threshold to east gate (v18-19). YHWH leaves His house reluctantly, by stages, as if pausing at each doorway.

- **10:14**: The first face is now 'cherub' rather than 'ox' (cf. 1:10). This substitution identifies the living creatures as cherubim and may reflect a tradition equating the cherub-face with the ox.

— EMET
